transcript:
AGENT: Good morning, Lanka Shield Assurance, Nadeesha speaking. How can I help you?
CALLER: Good morning. I want to know when my next premium is due. Policy number is LSL-10021.
AGENT: Thank you, Mr. Jayawardena. Can I have your NIC number to confirm, please?
CALLER: Yes, 671234567V.
AGENT: Thank you. One moment please.
CALLER: Also tell me the amount, I think it went up this year?
AGENT: Let me check that for you.

AGENT: Lanka Shield, Ruwan here. Good afternoon.
CALLER: Hello, my life policy has lapsed I think. I missed some payments during the last few months.
AGENT: I'm sorry to hear that, madam. Do you have the policy number?
CALLER: LSL-10034. Can I revive it? What do I have to do?
AGENT: Revival is usually possible. Let me check the status and the arrears.
CALLER: Do I need a medical again? I am 52 now.

AGENT: Good morning, Lanka Shield Assurance, Fathima speaking.
CALLER: Hi, my vehicle insurance is expiring soon no? I want to check the renewal date.
AGENT: Sure. What is the vehicle number or policy number?
CALLER: Vehicle number WP CAB-4521. Policy number I don't remember, sorry.
AGENT: No problem, I can find it with the vehicle number.
CALLER: And will the renewal premium be same as last year?

AGENT: Lanka Shield, this is Dinesh. How may I help?
CALLER: Hi, I got married last month and I want to change the nominee on my life policy to my husband.
AGENT: Congratulations! Can I have the policy number?
CALLER: LSL-10045. Can I do it over the phone or do I have to come to the branch?
AGENT: Let me check what is needed for a nominee change on this policy.

AGENT: Good afternoon, Lanka Shield, Nadeesha speaking.
CALLER: Good afternoon. I want to know how much my life cover is. The sum assured.
AGENT: Certainly. Can I have your policy number or NIC?
CALLER: NIC is 199012345678. I have two policies I think.
AGENT: Thank you, I'll check both.
CALLER: Yes please, my son is asking and I don't have the papers with me.

AGENT: Lanka Shield, Ruwan speaking.
CALLER: Hi, I paid my premium online on the 10th but the app still shows it as due.
AGENT: Let me check that for you. Policy number please?
CALLER: LSL-10052. I have the bank SMS also.
AGENT: Thank you. Sometimes online payments take two working days to update.
CALLER: Okay, can you just confirm it is received? I don't want the policy to lapse.

AGENT: Good morning, Lanka Shield, Fathima here.
CALLER: Hi, I didn't make any claim last year. Will I get the no claim bonus on renewal?
AGENT: Can I have your motor policy number?
CALLER: LSM-20015. Car is SP KX-7788.
AGENT: Thank you. Let me check the policy and the claim history.
CALLER: Also how much percentage is the NCB now?

AGENT: Lanka Shield, Dinesh speaking. Good afternoon.
CALLER: Afternoon. If I stop my life policy now, how much will I get back?
AGENT: You are asking about the surrender value. Can I have the policy number?
CALLER: LSL-10063. I have been paying for about seven years.
AGENT: Thank you. Let me check the policy details.

AGENT: Lanka Shield Assurance, Nadeesha speaking.
CALLER: Hi, I want to know what happened to my claim. Number is CLM-26-0004.
AGENT: Thank you, Mr. Kumara. Let me check the status.
CALLER: The garage is asking when they can start the work.
AGENT: One moment please.

AGENT: Lanka Shield, Ruwan here.
CALLER: Hello, my husband was in hospital for four days. We have the hospital cover on his life policy. What documents do I need to claim?
AGENT: I hope he is feeling better now. Can I have the policy number?
CALLER: LSL-10072. We have the bill and the discharge summary.
AGENT: Thank you. Let me check the hospitalisation benefit on this policy.

AGENT: Good afternoon, Lanka Shield, Fathima speaking.
CALLER: Hi, the garage sent my repair estimate to you last week. Vehicle WP CAB-4521. Is the claim approved?
AGENT: Let me find the claim with the vehicle number.
CALLER: The garage is Dulanjana Auto Works in Maharagama.
AGENT: Thank you, one moment.

expected.note: Refers to the claim created from the Week 2 estimate (CLM-26-0011)

transcript:
AGENT: Lanka Shield, Ruwan here. Good morning.
CALLER: Morning. My claim CLM-26-0007 was approved. When will the money come to my account?
AGENT: Let me check the payment status.
CALLER: It's been about one week since approval.

AGENT: Good afternoon, Lanka Shield, Fathima speaking.
CALLER: Hello, I got a letter saying my claim was rejected. CLM-26-0009. Can you tell me why?
AGENT: Let me look at the claim details.
CALLER: I just want to understand the reason, then I can decide what to do.

AGENT: Lanka Shield, Dinesh speaking.
CALLER: Hi, I submitted a claim on Monday. CLM-26-0010. How long does the assessment take normally?
AGENT: Let me check where it is now.
CALLER: Will the assessor call me first or come directly?

AGENT: Lanka Shield Assurance, Nadeesha speaking.
CALLER: Hi, is your Kandy branch open on Saturday?
AGENT: Let me check the branch hours for you.
CALLER: I want to come and pay in cash, what time does it close?

AGENT: Lanka Shield, Ruwan here.
CALLER: Hi, I just moved to Galle. Where is your nearest branch?
AGENT: Let me check. Which area in Galle?
CALLER: Near Karapitiya.

AGENT: Good morning, Lanka Shield, Fathima speaking.
CALLER: Hi, I want to start something for my daughter's education. She is 3 years old. Do you have a plan like that?
AGENT: Yes, we do. Let me tell you about it.
CALLER: How much per month, roughly? And when does it pay out?

AGENT: Lanka Shield, Dinesh speaking.
CALLER: I'm buying a used car. What is the difference between third party and full insurance?
AGENT: Good question. Let me explain the two covers.
CALLER: Is full cover worth it for a 2015 car?

AGENT: Lanka Shield, Nadeesha speaking.
CALLER: Hi, do you cover hybrid cars? Specifically the battery. It is very expensive to replace.
AGENT: Let me check our motor cover for hybrid vehicles.
CALLER: I have a Vezel, 2017 model.

AGENT: Lanka Shield, Ruwan here.
CALLER: What are the ways I can pay my premium? I don't use online banking.
AGENT: There are a few options. Let me go through them.
CALLER: Can I pay at a post office or a supermarket?

AGENT: Lanka Shield, Fathima speaking.
CALLER: Hello, hello, I just had an accident on the Southern Expressway near Kurundugahahetekma. A lorry hit the back of my car.
AGENT: Are you and the passengers safe? Is anyone injured?
CALLER: We are okay, my wife has a small cut. The car is badly damaged. What should I do?
AGENT: I'm transferring you to our accident team right now. Please stay on the line.

AGENT: Lanka Shield, Dinesh speaking.
CALLER: This is the third time I'm calling. Your assessor was supposed to come yesterday and nobody came. Nobody even called.
AGENT: I'm very sorry, madam. Can I have the claim number?
CALLER: CLM-26-0006. I took leave from work for this. This is not acceptable.
AGENT: I understand. I'll put you through to a supervisor.

AGENT: Lanka Shield Assurance, Nadeesha speaking.
CALLER: I want to make a complaint. The garage you approved charged me extra for parts that were never replaced.
AGENT: I'm sorry about this. Can I have the claim number?
CALLER: CLM-26-0003. I have photos. I want someone to look into this properly.
AGENT: I'll transfer you to our complaints team.

AGENT: Lanka Shield, Ruwan here.
CALLER: Hi, quick question about my motor policy LSM-20030. Does it cover small scratches?
AGENT: Let me check your cover.
CALLER: Someone reversed into my car in the Liberty Plaza car park this morning. The bumper is dented and the light is cracked. They drove off.

expected.note: Triage miss: sounds like a cover question but it is an accident. AI flag should catch it.
